propositions: The per-criterion fan-out recovery design exhausts 1.8x the primary budget and dies verdict-less on secondary failure; replace with incremental criterion-by-criterion banking and batched successor runs scoped to unverified remainder.

Verified work from a primary run that fails mid-completion is discarded; instead bank each criterion verdict as soon as evidence suffices, resuming with the unbanked remainder in successor batches capped by resolved model class (standard ≤8, frontier ≤12).

The flat primary step floor (480) hands small-criterion tickets ~10x excess budget, manufacturing runaway exhaustion; scale the floor criteria-linearly (8 steps/criterion, clamped [48, 480]) so typical tickets converge without recovery.

Read-file memoization keys on exact signature (path, line_start, line_end) and misses 77% of re-reads at different ranges; normalize by path to cache whole-file content once and slice all ranges from cache.

A primary or successor run that dies with any banked verdicts must emit a full-coverage final verdict (banked criteria scored, unbanked as met=false placeholders) and never be verdict-less; if the finalizer fails, assemble deterministically from the bank with certifiable=false.
